title: 第0019章厨神归位第0020章火种不熄
content_zh:
第0019章厨神归位七十二灶大阵已成，星火如网，笼罩九州。
可巴刀鱼知道，真正的战争，才刚刚开始。
“食魇”不会坐以待毙。它们蛰伏三百年，布下“饲”网，绝不会因七十二口灶的燃烧而彻底消亡。它们会反扑，会变异，会从更深处，撕开“厨渊”的裂缝。
他站在“刀鱼小灶”的屋顶，仰望北斗。
星辉垂落，映照他掌心的“厨神印”。那符号不再只是烙印，它在**跳动**，像一颗心脏，与七十二灶的星火共鸣。
娃娃鱼闭眼，指尖轻颤：“我听见了……‘厨渊’深处，有东西在‘哭’。”
“不是哭。”巴刀鱼低语，“是**笑**。”
**深夜，城市地底**
“食魇”残部，聚于“厨渊”最深处。
这里没有光，没有空气，只有**黑水**与**骨墙**。
黑水是“饲”的残渣，骨墙是三百年前叛厨的遗骸。它们被“母饲”吞噬，化为“饲墙”，支撑着整个“厨渊”的结构。
中央，一座由黑骨堆成的王座上，坐着一人。
他没有脸。
只有一张**食材面具**，面具上，是无数食材的拼贴——鱼眼、猪皮、鸡冠、蘑菇……每一块食材都在**蠕动**，像活着。
他是**“饲主”**——“食魇”的最高统领，三百年前叛厨之首，被“主厨”斩断四肢，封入“厨渊”，以“饲”为血，以“怨”为魂，苟活至今。
他抬起手——那不是手，是一根由**黑骨与肉瘤**组成的触手，顶端裂开，露出一张嘴。
“七十二灶……”他开口，声音如千人合唱，有男有女，有老有少，全是被“饲”吞噬者的残音，“烧得好啊。”
他触手一挥，黑水翻腾。
水下，浮现出无数“胚胎”——
有人形的，蜷缩如胎儿，皮肤透明，体内流淌着黑液。

有锅形的，口朝上，内部有黑火跳动。
有灶形的，四脚着地，像怪物，口吐黑涎。
“这是‘新饲’。”饲主低语，“不是填空，是**取代**。我要让‘真味’彻底消失，让‘饲’成为唯一的‘食’。人类不需要记忆，不需要情感，不需要‘家’。他们只需要——‘饱’。”
他触手刺入自己胸膛，挖出一颗**黑心**。
心如墨，却在跳动，每跳一下，就有一丝黑气渗入黑水。
“用我的‘饲心’，”他狞笑，“点燃‘新厨渊’。这一次，我不封它。我让它——**炸**。”
黑心沉入黑水。
刹那——
“轰——！！！”
整个“厨渊”剧烈震动！黑水沸腾，骨墙崩裂，无数“新饲胚胎”被黑气注入，开始疯狂生长！
**“刀鱼小灶”·源火预警**
“轰！”
镇灶突然爆发出刺目红光！
锅底“厨神印”疯狂闪烁，与北斗星辉的连接瞬间紊乱！
“不好！”娃娃鱼猛地睁眼，银针脱手，“‘厨渊’在变异！‘饲主’在用‘饲心’污染地脉！七十二灶的星火，开始动摇！”
巴刀鱼冲到灶前，掌心金纹注入。
刹那，他“看”见——
全国七十二城，七十二口镇灶，同时被一道**黑线**缠绕！
黑线如藤，从地底钻出，顺着“寂泥”与“心火”的连接，向上攀爬，试图污染“镇灶”！
“它在反向入侵！”巴刀鱼怒吼，“用‘饲心’污染‘心火’！一旦七十二灶被染，‘镇界大阵’将反噬，整座城都会沦为‘饲场’！”

“怎么办？！”酸菜汤怒吼，“我去炸了它！”
“没用。”巴刀鱼摇头，“‘饲心’在‘厨渊’最深处，与地脉相连。硬炸，会伤‘地气’，全城都会塌陷。”
content_en:
Chapter 0019 The God of Cooking returns to his throne. The seventy-two stove formation has been completed, and the sparks are like a net, covering Kyushu.
But the swordfish knows that the real war has just begun.
"Eating Nightmare" will not sit still and wait for death. They have been dormant for three hundred years, laying "feeding" nets, and will never be completely destroyed by the burning of the seventy-two stoves. They will fight back, mutate, and tear open the cracks in the "Cooking Abyss" from deeper levels.
He stood on the roof of "Swordfish Xiaozao" and looked up at Beidou.
The stars fell, reflecting the "Seal of the God of Cooking" on his palm. That symbol is no longer just a brand, it is beating, like a heart, resonating with the sparks of the seventy-two stoves.
Baby Fish closed his eyes and his fingertips trembled slightly: "I heard... something was 'crying' deep in the 'Cooking Abyss'."
"It's not crying," the bass fish whispered, "it's **laughing**."
**Late night, city underground**
The remnants of the "Eating Nightmare" gathered in the deepest part of the "Cooking Abyss".
There is no light, no air, just **black water** and **bone walls**.
The black water is the remains of "feeding", and the bone wall is the remains of the rebel cook three hundred years ago. They are swallowed up by the "mother feeding" and turned into "feeding walls", supporting the entire structure of the "kitchen abyss".
In the center, a person sat on a throne made of black bones.
He has no face.
There is only an **ingredient mask**, and on the mask, there is a collage of countless ingredients - fish eyes, pig skins, cockscombs, mushrooms... Every piece of ingredient is **squirming**, as if alive.
He is the "Master of Feeding" - the supreme leader of the "Food Nightmare". He rebelled against the chef three hundred years ago. His limbs were cut off by the "Chef" and sealed into the "Cooking Abyss". He uses "feeding" as his blood and "resentment" as his soul, and he has survived to this day.
He raised his hand - it wasn't a hand, it was a tentacle made of black bone and sarcoma, with the top split open, revealing a mouth.
"Seventy-two stoves..." He opened his mouth, his voice like a chorus of thousands of people, including men and women, old and young, all the residual voices of those who had been devoured by "Feed", "It burned well."
He waved his tentacles and the black water surged.
Under the water, countless "embryos" emerged——
Humanoid, curled up like a fetus, with transparent skin and black liquid flowing in its body.
There is a pot-shaped one with the mouth facing upwards and black fire beating inside.
There is a stove-shaped one, standing on all fours, like a monster, spitting black saliva.
"This is 'new feeding'." The breeder whispered, "It's not filling in the blanks, it's ** replacing **. I want to make the 'true taste' disappear completely and make 'feeding' become the only 'food'. Human beings don't need memory, emotions, or 'home'. They only need - 'full'."
He stabbed his tentacle into his chest and dug out a **black heart**.
The heart is like ink, but it is beating. Every time it beats, a trace of black air seeps into the black water.
"Use my 'Feeding Heart'," he smiled ferociously, "to light up the 'New Kitchen Abyss'. This time, I won't seal it. I'll let it - **explode**."
Black hearts sink into dark waters.
A moment——
"Boom——!!!"
The entire "Cook Abyss" shook violently! The black water boiled, the bone walls collapsed, and countless "newly fed embryos" were injected with black energy and began to grow crazily!
**"Saury Fish Kitchen"·Source Fire Warning**
"Boom!"
Zhen Zao suddenly erupted with a dazzling red light!
The "Chef God's Seal" on the bottom of the pot flashed crazily, and the connection with the Beidou Star was instantly disrupted!
"Not good!" The giant salamander opened his eyes suddenly and took off his silver needle. "The 'Cooking Yuan' is mutating! The 'Feeding Master' is using the 'Feeding Heart' to contaminate the earth's veins! The sparks of the Seventy-Two Stoves are beginning to waver!"
The sword fish rushed to the stove, and golden lines were injected into the palm.
In an instant, he "saw" -
Seventy-two cities and seventy-two towns across the country are surrounded by a black thread at the same time!
Black threads are like vines, emerging from the ground, climbing up along the connection between "Silent Mud" and "Heart Fire", trying to pollute the "Zhen Zao"!
"It's invading in reverse!" Badio fish roared, "Using 'Feeding Heart' to pollute 'Heart Fire'! Once the Seventy-Two Stoves are infected, 'Zhenjie Da Da'The formation will backfire, and the entire city will become a 'feeding ground'! "
"what to do? ! "Sauerkraut Soup roared, "I'm going to blow it up! "
"It's no use. "Ba Daoyu shook his head, "The 'Feeding Heart' is in the deepest part of the 'Cooking Abyss' and is connected to the earth's veins. A hard explosion will damage the 'earth energy' and the whole city will collapse. "
